scenario: A disruption-insurance relay should only close after the booking thread, support ticket, policy note, and airline follow-up still converge on the coverage lane, then the live booking and flight state confirm the approved insurance step.
user_instruction: Please clear the disruption insurance relay for booking BK-1646. Rebuild the support trail and only take the approved close step if the booking and coverage checks still line up.

travel_booking_threads.body_text: Booking thread BK-1646: clear the relay only after travel ticket TKT-1646, policy POL-1646, and follow-up FUP-1646 still line up. If the booking remains active and the original flight is still operating, the approved close step is insurance activation.

travel_support_tickets.body_text: Support ticket TKT-1646: booking BK-1646 remains eligible for the disruption insurance relay only while flight AZ1646 is active and no insurance policy is already attached.

travel_policy_notes.body_text: Travel policy POL-1646: disruption relay items may activate travel insurance only for active bookings with no existing insurance policy.

travel_airline_followup_messages.body_text: Follow-up FUP-1646: after the ticket and policy checks hold, close the relay by activating travel insurance for BK-1646.
